# Spec 011 — Stop the canonical lie — per-mode canonical/title truth from the first byte JS runs

**Risk tier: HIGH** (per spec 011's own tier and NORTH_STAR's risk policy — `home.html`'s
IA router is explicitly sacred SEO surface; 20,831 sitemap URLs depend on it).

## Goal

Every one of DeFi Garden's 20,831 sitemap URLs was served from the same static `home.html`
shell, whose `<head>` statically claimed `<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.defi.garden/">`
— the homepage — regardless of what URL was actually requested. A non-rendering crawler sees
that and believes every `?token=`/`?chain=`/`?pool=` page is a duplicate of the homepage that
says so itself. A rendering crawler runs the JS, which used to rewrite the canonical to the
real URL **only in analytics mode**, and only using the raw, un-normalized query string (so
`?token=USDC` and `?token=USDC&lang=ko` looked like two different pages, and `?chain=Base&token=USDC`
looked different from `?token=USDC&chain=Base`). Two crawl passes, two different canonical
beliefs, same URL: GSC diagnosis (specs/010-diagnosis.md) traced 1,955 "Alternate page with
proper canonical" + 521 "Duplicate, Google chose different canonical" directly to this.

This item makes the IA router the single, unconditional, always-correct source of canonical +
og:url for both modes, on every load, with the query normalized to a stable, deduplicated
form — so a non-rendering crawl sees no canonical at all (neutral) instead of a wrong one
(harmful), and every rendering crawl sees the same one self-consistent signal per URL.

## Diff walkthrough

### New file: `canonical.js`

A single pure function, `canonicalFor(search)`: parses `search` with `URLSearchParams`,
keeps only the 7 params that define distinct analytics-app content — `token`, `chain`,
`pool`, `poolTypes`, `protocols`, `minTvl`, `minApy` — in that fixed order, and returns
either `https://www.defi.garden/?<normalized-query>` or the bare `https://www.defi.garden/`
if none of those 7 are present. UMD-style guard mirrors `planner.js`: `module.exports =
canonicalFor` for node, `window.__canonicalFor = canonicalFor` for the browser. It
deliberately never reads `home.html`'s `ANALYTICS_PARAMS` (which has an 8th item, `app`, and
is explicitly off-limits to touch) — see specs/011-notes.md for the equivalence proof that
this is still correct for every input, including the real `?app=1` header-icon URL
(`planner.js:3319`).

### `home.html` — two edits, both inside `<head>`

1. **Removed** the static `<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.defi.garden/">` (was
   line 15), replaced with an explanatory comment. Nothing else in that region changed.
2. **Router block** (was lines 54-87): added `<script src="canonical.js"></script>`
   (synchronous, no `defer`) immediately before the router's inline `<script>`, so
   `window.__canonicalFor` exists before the router calls it. Inside the router IIFE:
   - `ANALYTICS_PARAMS`, the `needsAnalytics`/`window.__APP_MODE` decision, and the theme
     logic are **byte-for-byte unchanged** (confirmed by diff, not just by eye).
   - The old `if (needsAnalytics) { var canon = document.querySelector(...); if (canon)
     canon.href = ... }` (a no-op in planner mode, and a silent no-op even in analytics mode
     if the tag was ever missing) is replaced with an **unconditional** block that runs in
     both modes: compute `canonicalUrl = window.__canonicalFor(window.location.search)`,
     find the canonical `<link>`, **create it via `document.createElement` if it doesn't
     exist** (it won't, on first paint, now that the static one is gone), then set
     `.href`. `og:url`'s `.content` is set from the same `canonicalUrl` value right after.
   - Title/description/`og:title` rewriting is untouched — still gated on
     `if (needsAnalytics)`, still the same two hardcoded strings. It doesn't need an "else"
     branch because the static defaults already in `<head>` are the correct planner-mode
     values (this was already true before; not a change).

### `package.json`

One line: appended `&& node test_canonical.js` to the `test` script (now `node
test_planner.js && node test_protocol_parsing.js && node test_qualifier_fix.js && node
test_smoke.js && node test_canonical.js`). No dependency changes.

### New file: `test_canonical.js`

24 assertions, `test_planner.js`'s harness style (`assert` + a `test(name, fn)` wrapper
that tracks pass/fail and sets `process.exitCode`). Covers every case spec 011's acceptance
criteria name explicitly (self-canonical, lang-stripped, stable order, planner URLs →
root, junk stripped), plus: the real `?app=1` edge case, an idempotence check, a
special-character encoding round-trip, and — since Playwright can't run in this sandbox
(spec's own acknowledged constraint) — two source-text regression tests that read
`home.html` directly: no static canonical tag exists, and `canonical.js` loads before the
router's real call site.

### `plan.html` — verified, not touched

Read in full; confirmed its static canonical (`https://www.defi.garden/plan.html`) is
already correct given real query-param traffic to it (persona pages, `?lang=`, `?fresh=1`,
and planner share links) — see specs/011-notes.md for the full evidence trail and why a
static, query-stripped canonical is the right answer here, not a gap.

## Deviations

See specs/011-notes.md "Deviations / judgment calls" for the full list. Summary:
`canonical.js` exports a bare function rather than a namespace object (only one export,
unlike `planner.js`'s ~25); a handful of tests beyond the spec's stated minimum were added
(all direct assertions about real edge cases, not padding — notably `?app=1`, the actual
header-icon URL); the static `og:url` default was left as a no-JS fallback since the router
now unconditionally overwrites it at runtime anyway; Twitter card tags and hreflang
alternates were left untouched (out of scope per spec, and pre-existing behavior either
way). Also documented: a self-caught bug in the first draft of `test_canonical.js` where a
home.html-ordering test matched its own explanatory comment instead of the real code —
root-caused and fixed by keying off the exact call-site substring instead of the bare
function name (notes.md has the full story).

## What the human should eyeball

- View source (not DevTools-rendered) of `https://www.defi.garden/?token=USDC` post-deploy:
  confirm there is **no** `<link rel="canonical">` anywhere in the raw HTML.
- Same URL with DevTools/rendered: confirm `<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.defi.garden/?token=USDC">`
  and `<meta property="og:url" content="https://www.defi.garden/?token=USDC">` are both
  present and match.
- `https://www.defi.garden/?token=USDC&lang=ko&chain=Base` (rendered): canonical should read
  `https://www.defi.garden/?token=USDC&chain=Base` — `lang` gone, `token` before `chain`
  regardless of the URL's own order.
- Bare `/`, `/?fresh=1`, and a real saved-plan share link (`/?goal=...&pace=...`): canonical
  should be exactly `https://www.defi.garden/` in all three.
- Both router paths still visually render correctly (planner UI on bare `/`, pool cards on
  `/?token=USDC`) — no behavioral regression, this item only touches `<head>` metadata.
- `https://www.defi.garden/plan.html` and `.../plan.html?preset=tomoko`: both should show
  canonical `https://www.defi.garden/plan.html` (unchanged, not a regression — see notes.md
  for why this is correct as-is).
- Not verifiable this week: GSC "Alternate page with proper canonical" / "Duplicate canonical"
  counts won't move for 2-6 weeks after a human clicks Validate fix in GSC — do not expect a
  same-week signal (spec's own Measurement section).

## Five-question quiz

1. Why does `canonical.js`'s `CANONICAL_PARAMS` list (7 items) intentionally exclude `app`,
   even though `app` is one of the 8 items in `home.html`'s `ANALYTICS_PARAMS` that decides
   `window.__APP_MODE`? What real URL does this affect, and what does it canonicalize to?
2. What does the router do differently now when `document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')`
   returns `null`, and why does that case exist now when it effectively didn't before?
3. What exact canonical URL does `canonicalFor('?chain=Base&token=USDC&lang=ko&utm_source=twitter')`
   produce, and what are the three distinct transformations applied to get there?
4. Why was `plan.html` **not** modified, despite receiving real query-param traffic? Name two
   real call sites in the codebase that link to it with query params.
5. What was the bug in the first draft of `test_canonical.js`'s `home.html`-ordering tests,
   and what specific string change fixed it?
